description: The checks Argus runs: the state of every target and of each address behind it, latency split by phase, and everything the http, tls, dns, icmp, tcp, udp, grpc, domain and external probes measure.

panels.title: Targets watched
panels.description: Distinct probe/target pairs in the current selection.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: A target is down only when every one of its addresses is.

panels.title: Availability over range
panels.description: Mean probe_up across every address, over the selected range.

panels.title: Requests that passed
panels.description: probe_success_total over probe_total, both counted per request.

panels.title: p95 duration
panels.description: The prober's own time; name resolution is not in it.

panels.title: Addresses not answering
panels.description: Resolved addresses that did not answer their last run.

panels.title: Availability by probe
panels.description: Share of a probe's addresses answering right now.

panels.title: Failures per minute, by reason
panels.description: dns · connect · tls · timeout · status · content · protocol · internal · unknown

panels.title: Target state
panels.description: One band per target. A gap is a window in which none of its addresses answered.

panels.title: Targets
panels.description: Every number a target has, on one line. Columns sort and filter.

panels.title: What the patterns matched
panels.description: probe_expect_info: one label per named capture group in an expect, body_regex, header_regex or answer_regex. Add more columns here for the groups your probes name.

panels.title: Duration quantiles
panels.description: Across the whole selection; name resolution excluded. The dashed line is the probe's timeout: the ceiling this latency is measured against.

panels.title: Duration distribution
panels.description: probe_duration_seconds as the probe recorded it, no re-bucketing.

panels.title: Connection phases, p95
panels.description: connect · tls · write · ttfb · transfer, from the connection trace.

panels.title: Slowest targets
panels.description: Ten worst by their last run.

panels.title: Resolutions per minute
panels.description: Cache hits are not counted.

panels.title: Failed resolutions per minute, by server
Answer TTL
panels.description: Clamped by resolver.min_ttl and resolver.max_ttl.

panels.title: Answers from the other address family, per minute
panels.description: ip_fallback had to switch families to get an answer.

panels.title: Addresses per target: resolved and up
Addresses
panels.description: One row per address of a target — the granularity Argus exists for.

panels.title: Status code by target
panels.description: The last response's code; coloured by class.

panels.title: Response body size
panels.description: Read off the wire against what the server declared.

panels.title: Failing validators
panels.description: Empty means every assertion under validators: passed.

panels.title: Protocol and final URL
panels.description: final_url is only written with expose_final_url: true.

panels.title: Age of the served document
panels.description: now − Last-Modified. A frozen cache shows up here.

panels.title: Days until the leaf certificate expires
panels.description: The fifteen most urgent. Negative means already expired.

panels.title: Days until the chain expires
panels.description: The weakest link: an expiring intermediate shows here rather than in the leaf.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: The fingerprint changes exactly when the server starts serving another certificate — a diff, not a guess.

panels.title: Certificates revoked
panels.description: Reported revoked by OCSP. Needs tls_config.check_revoked on the probe.

panels.title: OCSP
panels.description: good · revoked · unknown · stale (the answer is past its nextUpdate) · unavailable (the responder could not be asked).

panels.title: Unanswered queries per minute, by resolver
panels.description: A resolver that times out counts as a failure.

panels.title: Resolvers agree
panels.description: Written only with compare_servers: true.

panels.title: Zone SOA serial
panels.description: A lagging secondary shows as lines drifting apart.

panels.title: Answer
panels.description: The record set as one string, TTLs stripped, so it changes only when the data does. Disagreement between resolvers reads row by row.

panels.title: Transport phases
panels.description: Connecting against answering. A DoT resolver slow to shake hands is a different problem from one slow to answer; over udp there is only query.

panels.title: Jitter
panels.description: Mean deviation from the average RTT.

panels.title: Reply hop limit
panels.description: Hops on the return path; a route change is a step.

panels.title: Duplicate replies
panels.description: A second reply to a packet already answered — a broadcast address, or an anycast set answering twice.

panels.title: Days until the registration expires
panels.description: Registry data over RDAP, answered by the registry rather than the host.

panels.title: Domains without a transfer lock
panels.description: clientTransferProhibited is off: the name can be moved.

panels.title: TCP · unix · UDP · WebSocket · gRPC · external
unix: bytes read
panels.description: Bytes read over the socket. For unixgram this is the whole datagram, not what read_bytes kept for matching.

panels.title: UDP: reply size
panels.description: Zero means the probe waited for an ICMP refusal instead of a reply.

panels.title: WebSocket: handshake
panels.description: 101 is the only success. A proxy that forwards HTTP and drops Upgrade answers 200 here and looks healthy to every other check.

panels.title: WebSocket: message size
panels.description: Size of the message the server sent back, with send/expect.

panels.title: WebSocket: subprotocol
panels.description: What the server chose from the offered list.

panels.title: external: metrics parsed
panels.description: name value lines accepted from stdout in mode: output.

panels.title: Series held
panels.description: The ceiling is probing.max_series.

panels.title: Samples dropped
panels.description: Non-zero means max_series was reached and measurements are lost.

panels.title: Concurrency slots
panels.description: Pinned at the limit means probes queue, and the wait is inside their timings.

panels.title: Runs skipped, panics and pauses
panels.description: A skip means the previous run was still going: the interval is shorter than the check takes.

panels.title: Age of the discovered target list
panels.description: A source that stopped answering keeps serving its last good list — that shows here.
